title: Arbeitszimmer annual flat amount
summary: Instead of actual costs, a flat 1,260 EUR per calendar year can be deducted for a work room (Arbeitszimmer). The amount reduces by one twelfth for each full calendar month in which the conditions are not met. It cannot be combined with the Tagespauschale for the same period.
conditions: The work room is the centre (Mittelpunkt) of the whole professional activity
Either actual costs or the annual flat amount can be claimed, not both
The annual flat amount is reduced by one twelfth for each full calendar month in which the conditions are not met
If the room is not the centre of the activity, the daily home-office flat rate may be claimed instead
Equipment in the room (desk, computer) is work equipment, not part of the room costs
notes: Conditions taken from the ELSTER 2025 instructions (Zeile 52) and the BMF letter of 15 August 2023 it cites.
